technology_name: Adaptive Traffic Monitoring and Management Platform (TraMM-EnV)
institution: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)
problem_solved: Difficulty in monitoring and controlling adaptive traffic systems remotely
description: TraMM-EnV is a traffic management software platform that supports monitoring and management of adaptive traffic signal controllers. It provides visualization, analytics, and remote control capabilities for traffic operations within urban transportation networks.
applications:
Smart city and intelligent transportation system (ITS) projects
Traffic management centers and urban local bodies
Transportation analytics and mobility management organizations
Traffic signal system integrators and smart infrastructure providers
Government agencies implementing adaptive traffic monitoring and urban mobility solutions
